|lore=Symbol for the Cloud City Miner’s Guild (not affiliated with the Galactic Miner’s Guild). Named after the beldons, giant creatures who generate Tibanna gas.
|game_text=Deploy on table. If Quiet Mining Colony or Independent Operation on table: Once per game you may simultaneously deploy a unique (•) Independent starfighter and/or unique (•) matching pilot from your hand and/or Reserve Deck for free. Whenever your Independent starfighter piloted by an alien is targeted by a starship weapon, subtract the ability of the alien from each weapon destiny. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history=Versions of [[Beldon's Eye (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 1, slip 3 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Deploy on table. If Quiet Mining Colony or Independent Operation on table: Once per game you may simultaneously deploy a unique (•) Independent starfighter and/or unique (•) matching pilot from your hand and/or Reserve Deck for free. Whenever your Independent starfighter piloted by an alien is targeted by a starship weapon, subtract the ability of the alien from each weapon destiny. A” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•3” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-03-Beldons_Eye-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Beldon's Eye (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 3), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Your [Independent] starships are defense value +2 at Bespin locations. Once per game, if Quiet Mining Colony on table, may simultaneously deploy a unique (•) [Independent] starfighter and matching pilot (for -1 Force each) from your hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
